tools.name: get_shared_resume
tools.description:
Fetch an owner-published CVder resume by its share link or slug.

        Accepts a full share URL (https://cvder.app/cv/rsm_...) or a bare
        rsm_ slug. Only resumes the owner has explicitly shared are
        reachable; email, phone and location are redacted by the server.

        format: "r

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_shared_resume · Public sink: get_shared_resume · Destructive: get_shared_resume.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_shared_resume · Public sink: get_shared_resume · Destructive: get_shared_resume

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
